name: omnissiah
description: A generic, domain-agnostic Claude Code engineering framework. Provides agents, commands, skills, hooks, and rules for consistent AI-assisted development across Python, C++, and TypeScript.
features: Security-aware code review of uncommitted changes
Automated formatting (Ruff for Python, ESLint for Vue/TS, cppcheck for C++)
Secret detection to prevent credential exposure in commits
Session persistence for cross-session context continuity
Instinct-based continuous learning from developer sessions
Multi-agent orchestration workflows (plan, TDD, review, security)

changelog.0.1.0: Initial release with agents, commands, skills, hooks, rules, and MCP configuration
